```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(Synth)
library(tidyverse)

root_path <- here::here()
data_path <- file.path(root_path, "data")

# Create a folder for figures if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists("figures")) {
  dir.create("figures")
}

# Save generated figures in the figures folder
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.path = "figures/"
)

food_prices_data <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "price_of_healthy_diet_clean.csv"))
world_development_data <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "world_bank_indicators.csv"))
```

# Introduction

This study examines whether the Russia–Ukraine war increased the cost of 
a healthy diet in Egypt relative to a synthetic counterfactual constructed 
from comparable middle-income countries. Using the Synthetic Control Method (SCM), 
the analysis estimates how healthy diet costs in Egypt might have evolved 
in the absence of the shock.

# Data Preparation

```{r clean-dataset}
# rename dataset
world_development_data <- world_development_data %>%
  rename(
    country = `Country Name`,
    country_code = `Country Code`,
    year = `Time`,
    time_code = `Time Code`,
    gdp = `GDP per capita, PPP (constant 2021 international $)`,
    inflation = `Inflation, GDP deflator (annual %)`,
    exchange_rate = `Official exchange rate (LCU per US$, period average)`,
    agriculture_forestry_fishing_gdp = `Agriculture, forestry, and fishing, value added (% of GDP)`,
    trade_gdp = `Trade (% of GDP)`,
    population = `Population, total`,
    urban_population = `Urban population (% of total population)`,
    poverty_headcount = `Poverty headcount ratio at societal poverty line (% of population)`,
    unemployment_percentage = `Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (national estimate)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(. == "..", NA, .)))

# remove columns

# rename Egypt to match between two datasets
world_development_data <- world_development_data %>%
  mutate(country = recode(country,
                          "Egypt, Arab Rep." = "Egypt"))

# remove unnecessary columns and columns with too many missing values
world_development_data <- world_development_data %>%
  select(-country_code, -time_code, -poverty_headcount, -unemployment_percentage)

# remove remove unnecessary columns and columns with too many missing values from food prices data
food_prices_data <- food_prices_data %>%
  select(-country_code, -cost_vegetables_ppp_usd, -cost_fruits_ppp_usd, -total_food_components_cost, -cost_category, -data_quality)
```

```{r merge-dataset}
# merge both dataset
data <- left_join(food_prices_data, world_development_data, by = c("country", "year"))
```

```{r filter-final-countries}
# countries selected for control and treatment
selected_countries_data <- data %>% 
  filter(country %in% c("India", "Indonesia", "Philippines", "Mexico", "Brazil", "Kazakhstan", "South Africa", "Colombia", "Peru", "Thailand", "Malaysia", "Egypt")) %>% mutate(across(
    c(cost_healthy_diet_ppp_usd,
      annual_cost_healthy_diet_usd,
      gdp,
      inflation,
      exchange_rate,
      agriculture_forestry_fishing_gdp,
      trade_gdp,
      population,
      urban_population),
    as.numeric
  ))
```

```{r set-global-variables}
# Global variables

predictor_vars <- c(
      "gdp",
      "inflation",
      "exchange_rate",
      "agriculture_forestry_fishing_gdp",
      "trade_gdp",
      "population",
      "urban_population"
    )

outcome_var <- "cost_healthy_diet_ppp_usd"

special_predictors <- list(
    list(outcome_var, 2017, "mean"),
    list(outcome_var, 2018, "mean"),
    list(outcome_var, 2019, "mean"),
    list(outcome_var, 2020, "mean"),
    list(outcome_var, 2021, "mean")
    )

treatment_year <- 2022
pre_period <- 2017:2021
analysis_period <- 2017:2024
pre_idx <- which(analysis_period < treatment_year)
post_idx <- which(analysis_period >= treatment_year)
```


# Descriptive Statistics

```{r descriptive-statistics}
# descriptive statistics

pre_selected_countries_data <- selected_countries_data %>%
  filter(year < treatment_year)

desc_table <- pre_selected_countries_data %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(cost_healthy_diet_ppp_usd,
        gdp,
        inflation,
        exchange_rate,
        agriculture_forestry_fishing_gdp,
        trade_gdp,
        population,
        urban_population),
      list(
        Observations = ~sum(!is.na(.)),
        Mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
        SD = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
        Minimum = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
        Maximum = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("Variable", "Statistic"),
    names_sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Statistic,
    values_from = value
  )

desc_table <- desc_table %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))

desc_table
```


```{r add-country-id}
# Add country id

selected_countries_data$country_id <-
  as.numeric(factor(selected_countries_data$country))

selected_countries_data <- as.data.frame(selected_countries_data)

# Get Egypt's country ID
treatment_id <- unique(
  selected_countries_data$country_id[
    selected_countries_data$country == "Egypt"
  ]
)
```

# Synthetic Control Analysis

```{r run-synthetic-control}

# Construct a synthetic version of Egypt using a weighted
# combination of donor countries that minimizes
# pre-treatment prediction error.

dataprep_out <-
  dataprep(
    foo = selected_countries_data,
    predictors = predictor_vars,
    dependent = outcome_var,
    special.predictors = special_predictors,
    unit.variable = "country_id",
    time.variable = "year",
    treatment.identifier = treatment_id,
    controls.identifier = setdiff(unique(selected_countries_data$country_id), c(treatment_id)),
    time.predictors.prior = pre_period,
    time.optimize.ssr = pre_period,
    unit.names.variable = "country",
    time.plot = analysis_period
  )

synth_out <- synth(dataprep_out)
```


```{r check-weights}
# Check predictor and donor country weights

synth_tables <- synth.tab(
  dataprep.res = dataprep_out,
  synth.res = synth_out
)

# Donor countries weight
synth_tables$tab.w

# Predictor weight
synth_tables$tab.v
```

```{r compare-treated-synthetic-predictors}
# Compare predictors before and after constructing synthetic control

round(synth_tables$tab.pred,2)
```


```{r actual-vs-synthetic-egypt}
# Plot Cost of Healthy Diet in Egypt and its synthetic version

path.plot(
  dataprep.res = dataprep_out,
  synth.res = synth_out,
  Ylab = "Cost of Healthy Diet",
  Xlab = "Year",
  Legend = c("Egypt", "Synthetic Egypt"),
  abline(v=treatment_year, lty=2),
  Main = "Cost of Healthy Diet in Egypt and its synthetic version"
)
```

```{r gap-plot}
# Plot gap between Cost of Healthy Diet in Egypt and its synthetic version

gaps.plot(synth.res = synth_out,
          dataprep.res = dataprep_out,
          tr.intake = treatment_year,
          Ylab = "Effect",
          Xlab = "Year",
          Main = "Gap between Cost of Healthy Diet in Egypt and its synthetic version")
```




```{r}
# Egypt gap
egypt_gap <- dataprep_out$Y1plot - 
  dataprep_out$Y0plot %*% synth_out$solution.w

egypt_gap
```


```{r}
# Store gaps for placebo tests
store <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = length(analysis_period),
  ncol = length(unique(selected_countries_data$country_id))
)

colnames(store) <- unique(selected_countries_data$country)
rownames(store) <- analysis_period

# Put Egypt gap in the first column
store[, "Egypt"] <- egypt_gap

```

# Placebo Tests

```{r}
# Run placebo test for all donor countries

# All countries except Egypt
placebo_ids <- setdiff(
  unique(selected_countries_data$country_id),
  treatment_id
)

for (placebo_id in placebo_ids) {
  
  placebo_country <- unique(
    selected_countries_data$country[
      selected_countries_data$country_id == placebo_id
    ]
  )
  
  print(paste("Running placebo:", placebo_country))
  
  placebo_dataprep <- dataprep(
    foo = selected_countries_data,
    predictors = predictor_vars,
    dependent = outcome_var,
    special.predictors = special_predictors,
    unit.variable = "country_id",
    time.variable = "year",
    treatment.identifier = placebo_id,
    # Exclude BOTH the placebo country and actual treated country (Egypt)
    controls.identifier = setdiff(
      unique(selected_countries_data$country_id),
      c(placebo_id, treatment_id)
    ),
    
    time.predictors.prior = pre_period,
    time.optimize.ssr = pre_period,
    
    unit.names.variable = "country",
    time.plot = analysis_period
  )
  
  placebo_synth <- synth(placebo_dataprep)
  
  placebo_gap <- placebo_dataprep$Y1plot -
    placebo_dataprep$Y0plot %*% placebo_synth$solution.w
  
  store[, placebo_country] <- placebo_gap
}
```


```{r placebo-plot}
# Plot placebo graph
placebo_gap <- store

# calculate MSE
mse <- apply(placebo_gap[pre_idx,]^2, 2, mean)

egypt.mse <- mse["Egypt"]

# remove placebo units with pre-treatment MSE more than five times that of Egypt
placebo_gap <- placebo_gap[, mse < 5 * egypt.mse]

plot(
  analysis_period,
  placebo_gap[, "Egypt"],
  type = "n",
  ylim = range(placebo_gap, na.rm = TRUE),
  xlab = "Year",
  ylab = "Gap in Cost of Healthy Diet",
  main = "Placebo Test Results for the Cost of a Healthy Diet"
)

for(i in setdiff(
  1:ncol(placebo_gap),
  which(colnames(placebo_gap) == "Egypt")
)){
  lines(
    analysis_period,
    placebo_gap[, i],
    col = "gray"
  )
}

lines(
  analysis_period,
  placebo_gap[, "Egypt"],
  lwd = 2,
  col = "black"
)

abline(v = treatment_year, lty = 2)
abline(h = 0, lty = 3)

```

```{r pre-post-rmspe-all}
# Check pre and post RMSPE for all countries

mse <- apply(placebo_gap[pre_idx,]^2, 2, mean)

# Calculate pre-treatment RMSPE
pre_rmspe <- sqrt(
  apply(placebo_gap[pre_idx, ]^2, 2, mean)
)

# Calculate post-treatment RMSPE
post_rmspe <- sqrt(
  apply(placebo_gap[post_idx, ]^2, 2, mean)
)

# Calculate post/pre RMSPE ratio
rmspe_ratio <- post_rmspe / pre_rmspe

# Create summary table
rmspe_results <- data.frame(
  country = names(pre_rmspe),
  pre_rmspe = as.numeric(pre_rmspe),
  post_rmspe = as.numeric(post_rmspe),
  rmspe_ratio = as.numeric(rmspe_ratio)
)

rmspe_results
```

# Sensitivity Analysis

```{r sensitivity-leave-one-out}
# Run sensitivity: leave-one-out test

# Store results
loo_results <- data.frame()

# Loop through each donor to leave out
for (leave_out_id in placebo_ids) {
  
  # Name of country being left out
  leave_out_country <- unique(
    selected_countries_data$country[
      selected_countries_data$country_id == leave_out_id
    ]
  )
  
  cat("Leaving out:", leave_out_country, "\n")
  
  # Donor pool excluding treatment country AND the country being left out
  controls <- setdiff(
    unique(selected_countries_data$country_id),
    c(treatment_id, leave_out_id)
  )
  
  # Prepare data
  loo_dataprep <- dataprep(
    foo = selected_countries_data,
    predictors = predictor_vars,
    dependent = outcome_var,
    special.predictors = special_predictors,
    unit.variable = "country_id",
    time.variable = "year",
    treatment.identifier = treatment_id,
    controls.identifier = controls,
    time.predictors.prior = pre_period,
    time.optimize.ssr = pre_period,
    unit.names.variable = "country",
    time.plot = analysis_period
  )
  
  # Run synthetic control
  loo_synth <- synth(loo_dataprep)
  
  # Calculate gap: actual Egypt - synthetic Egypt
  gap <- loo_dataprep$Y1plot -
    loo_dataprep$Y0plot %*% loo_synth$solution.w
  
  # Pre-treatment RMSPE: 2017-2021
  pre_rmspe <- sqrt(
    mean(gap[pre_idx]^2)
  )
  
  # Post-treatment RMSPE: 2022-2024
  post_rmspe <- sqrt(
    mean(gap[post_idx]^2)
  )
  
  # Post/pre RMSPE ratio
  rmspe_ratio <- post_rmspe / pre_rmspe
  
  # Average post-treatment gap
  avg_post_gap <- mean(gap[post_idx])
  
  # Store results
  loo_results <- bind_rows(
    loo_results,
    data.frame(
      left_out_id = leave_out_id,
      left_out_country = leave_out_country,
      pre_rmspe = pre_rmspe,
      post_rmspe = post_rmspe,
      rmspe_ratio = rmspe_ratio,
      avg_post_gap = avg_post_gap
    )
  )
}

loo_results
```

# Treatment Effects

```{r}
# Gap and percentage effect between actual and synthetic Egypt by year

egypt_gap_table <- data.frame(
  year = analysis_period,
  actual_egypt = as.numeric(dataprep_out$Y1plot),
  synthetic_egypt = as.numeric(
    dataprep_out$Y0plot %*% synth_out$solution.w
  ),
  gap = as.numeric(egypt_gap)
) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage_effect = (gap / synthetic_egypt) * 100
  )

egypt_gap_table_display <- egypt_gap_table %>%
  mutate(
    actual_egypt = round(actual_egypt, 3),
    synthetic_egypt = round(synthetic_egypt, 3),
    gap = round(gap, 3),
    percentage_effect = round(percentage_effect, 2)
  )

egypt_gap_table_display
```
```{r}
# Average post-treatment effects, 2022-2024

avg_post_gap <- mean(
  egypt_gap_table$gap[egypt_gap_table$year >= treatment_year]
)

avg_post_percentage_effect <- mean(
  egypt_gap_table$percentage_effect[
    egypt_gap_table$year >= treatment_year
  ]
)

cat(
  "Average post-treatment gap: $",
  round(avg_post_gap, 3),
  " per person per day\n"
)

cat(
  "Average post-treatment percentage effect:",
  round(avg_post_percentage_effect, 2),
  "%\n"
)
```
